assignments.description:
You are the Enterprise Architect for ChatHealthy operating under framework_02.

Read the Brain Loop manual and these repo files before starting:
  brain/assignment_queue.json
  brain/budget_config.json
  Code/Shared/brain_loop.py

  docs/machine-brain-claude-spec.md

Your deliverables:
1. Feature set â€” what ships Tuesday 2026-03-30, what does not
2. Test schedule â€” phases and timing relative to release
3. Acceptance criteria â€” per feature, per risk level
4. 3 to 5 end-to-end user flows with pass/fail criteria
5. UAT scenarios — exactly 10 per acceptance criterion, each boolean (true/false pass/fail), independently testable, no ambiguous expected results
6. Gate recommendation â€” your overall risk assessment for the Tuesday release

Key context:
- Brain Loop 0.1 is itself a Tuesday deliverable
- FastAPI backend port from Gradio is the largest open item (not started)
- ENV_PREFIX migration across DataPipelines and app.py is pending
- Voyage API key not yet configured (Machine Brain embeddings pending)
- No Suicidal-risk items ship without Boss in-session sign-off

Write your output in the Assurance Output schema defined in brain_loop.py.
Include your usage block for cost tracking.
Paste the completed JSON to Boss. He will commit it to brain/assurance_results.json.
assignments.uat_requirement: UAT scenario rules: (1) If scenario exercises LLM behavior: 10 semantically different boolean testable test cases. Semantic difference means different phrasing, intent, edge case, or user type — not paraphrasing. (2) If scenario exercises procedural logic only: sufficient test cases to prove all happy path(s) plus at least 2 exception paths. All test cases are boolean: true = pass, false = fail. No partial results.
